reason: I've already caught someone double-claiming, so a free scan of my old group chats is worth uploading on its own. If it finds even one duplicate, $19 or $45 a month costs less than one inflated receipt, and I get my money back if it turns out to be useless.
objection: I'm not sure my staff and I will keep using it once the free part is over. With 2-4 groups, I'll probably go past 100 receipts and end up on the $45 plan, and a spreadsheet nobody opens is just another thing I'm paying for.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check finds nothing in my old chats, I won't pay. If it finds real duplicates, I'm in.
